name: stack-trace

frames.best_why: Expanded with the header, both icons and every stack frame visible and nothing overlapping.

tagline: Red error bar unfolds into dimmed monospace call frames.
summary: A compact error panel showing the error type and message with copy and expand controls. Opening it lists each call frame and greys out library and runtime internals.
appearance: A wide dark rounded panel. Its header pairs a small warning triangle, a red error type, a white message and two icon buttons; expanded, a bordered body underneath lists monospace frames line by line.
behaviour: Clicking the header or the chevron unfolds the frame list with a fade and flips the chevron. The copy button writes the raw trace to the clipboard and briefly shows a tick, while frames from node_modules and node internals sit dimmed.
demo_content: Fake TypeError about reading 'lineItems' during checkout, with seven frames across app and node_modules files.
search_phrases: show a javascript error call list
exception details with a copy button
hide library frames in a stack
console crash report with file paths
runtime error banner with line numbers
use_when: A developer tool or assistant answer needs to show a real runtime error without dumping raw text.
avoid_when: It is dense monospace content for developers, the message truncates, and it wants a wide container.
customise: The raw trace string, open state and a file-path click handler are props; the header, body and buttons are assembled from the exported sub-parts.
weight_why: A parsed string and a short list of frame rows behind one fade and border transition.

a11y.note: The copy and chevron controls are icon-only with no accessible names, so screen readers hear bare buttons.

props.name: onFilePathClick
props.type: (filePath: string, line?: number, column?: number) => void

issues: The message is cut with an ellipsis, so a long error can never be read in full from the header.
polish_why: Clear hierarchy and dimmed internal frames; truncated message and unnamed icons hold it back.
title: Stack Trace
